objective: 해당 머신이 바쁠때 우리 익스텐션의 성능이 떨어져, 사실 git만 사용하는 익스텐션이고 그래프를 랜더링하는 단순한 확장이라 성능 저하가 많지 않아야 해.

requirements.observedSelfInducedContention: 34 overlapping reported rev-parse windows from 34 cwd paths; current candidate anchor is one worktree. Sanitized observation saved.
requirements.reduceWorkAndConcurrency: 34-directory Native discovery 34->1; Graph startup Git calls 44->11 and owned peak slots 36->3 in completed comparisons.
requirements.verifyConstrainedResponse: 75ms read-start delay/3 preparation slots and Chromium CPU throttle 6; four completed independent Native/DOM cases. First frame median 1578.5->787.5ms and last frame 1794.5->1008ms.
requirements.preserveCorrectness: 64 Node cases, 48 protected discovery bursts, 12 normal Native/DOM startup cases, 4 constrained Native/DOM cases, and 11 actual controls with 80 PR cards and stale local changes.
requirements.boundAdditionalWork: Filesystem ancestor depth64 and pending map512; pending-only FS sharing, existing 5-second root cache, fresh branch reads, no new product timer/worker/watcher.
requirements.completeDelivery: Same verified VSIX published and installed; all 126 installed runtime files match.

limitations: Controlled scheduling/CPU limits are a reproduction model, not a claim of testing every kind of whole-machine contention.
Normal comparative runs did not keep the entire machine at the initially observed 88% CPU; machine-wide stress was not generated.
Performance ratios are scoped to the documented owned input and two independent Node lifetimes/source/mode. RSS is sampled, not a physical/retained peak.
Renderer code and GitHub network behavior were not changed; necessary Native Git work still depends on machine resources.
Existing user Host was not forced to reload and active Host version was not verified.
